### Kimball Electronics Reports Q1 Results Highlighted by the Return to Top-Line Growth; Company Reiterates Guidance for Fiscal 2027 With Sales Expected at the High End of the Range


November 4, 2026


First Quarter 2027 Highlights


- Net sales of $390.8 million, a 5% increase sequentially and up 7% compared to Q1 fiscal 2026
- Year-over-year organic sales growth of 3%, driven by increases in all verticals
- Medical sales increased 14% with 9% organic growth
- Operating income of $12.4 million, or 3.2% of net sales; adjusted operating income margin of 4.3% of net sales
- Cash Conversion Days of 82, equaling the multiyear low from last quarter
- Debt totaling $235.7 million, cash of $72.8 million, and borrowing capacity of $198.0 million
- Invested $3.1 million to repurchase 127,000 shares of common stock
- Company reiterates guidance for fiscal 2027 with sales expected at the high end of the range, driven by continued strength in the Medical vertical


JASPER, Ind.,--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Kimball Electronics, Inc. (Nasdaq: KE) today announced financial results for the first quarter ended September 30, 2026.

Commenting on today’s announcement, Richard D. Phillips, Chief Executive Officer, stated, “I’m encouraged by our first quarter results and solid start to fiscal 2027. Sales increased both sequentially and year-over-year, margins were healthy, and cash conversion days were once again at a multiyear low. The top line benefited from organic sales growth and the contribution from Helvoet Polymer Technologies, our recent tuck-in acquisition in the medical CDMO. The organic growth was in line with expectations and driven by a high single-digit increase in Medical. This growth aligns with our strategic focus to balance the portfolio across the verticals.”


Mr. Phillips continued, “Our excitement for the overall fit and growth opportunities of Helvoet are higher now than ever. With the backdrop of a strong balance sheet, we’re investing in medical growth by integrating Helvoet, ramping operations in Indianapolis, leveraging our capabilities as a full service provider, and unlocking synergies across our global footprint. Fiscal 2027 marks an important milestone in our journey and we are reiterating our guidance for the year with sales expected at the high end of the range, driven by continued strength in Medical.”

**FISCAL YEAR 2027 GUIDANCE**


As part of today’s announcement, the Company reiterated its guidance for fiscal 2027 with net sales expected at the high end of the range of $1,535 - $1,560 million, adjusted operating income of 4.4% - 4.7% of net sales, and capital expenditures of $50 - $60 million.

**Forward-Looking Statements**


Certain statements contained within this release are considered forward-looking, including our guidance, under the Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995. The statements may be identified by the use of words such as “expect,” “should,” “goal,” “predict,” “will,” “future,” “optimistic,” “confident,” and “believe.” Undue reliance should not be placed on these forward-looking statements. These statements are based on current expectations of future events and thus are inherently subject to uncertainty. If underlying assumptions prove inaccurate or known or unknown risks or uncertainties materialize, actual results could vary materially from our expectations and projections. These forward-looking statements are subject to risks and uncertainties including, without limitation, global economic conditions, geopolitical environment and conflicts such as war, global health emergencies, availability or cost of raw materials and components, tariffs and other trade barriers, foreign exchange rate fluctuations, and our ability to convert new business opportunities into customers and revenue. Additional cautionary statements regarding other risk factors that could have an effect on the future performance of the company are contained in its Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended June 30, 2026.


**Non-GAAP Financial Measures**


This press release contains non-GAAP financial measures. The non-GAAP financial measures contained herein include organic sales growth, adjusted selling and administrative expenses, adjusted operating income, adjusted EBITDA, adjusted net income, and adjusted diluted EPS. Reconciliations of the reported GAAP numbers to these non-GAAP financial measures are included in the Reconciliation of Non-GAAP Financial Measures section below. Management believes these measures are useful and allow investors to meaningfully trend, analyze, and benchmark the performance of the company’s core operations. The company’s non-GAAP financial measures are not necessarily comparable to non-GAAP information used by other companies.


**About Kimball Electronics/Kimball Solutions**


Kimball Electronics is a global, multifaceted manufacturer offering Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) and Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) solutions to customers around the world. From our operations in the United States, China, India, Mexico, The Netherlands, Poland, Romania, and Thailand, our teams are proud to provide manufacturing services for a variety of industries. Recognized for a reputation of excellence, we are committed to a high-performance culture that values quality, reliability, value, speed, and ethical behavior. Kimball Electronics, Inc. (Nasdaq: KE) is headquartered in Jasper, Indiana.


To learn more about Kimball Electronics, visit[www.kimballelectronics.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.kimballelectronics.com&esheet=54635348&newsitemid=20261104586900&lan=en-US&anchor=www.kimballelectronics.com&index=3&md5=bfdf7c6d785ea88332a6bbc608f15e33) .
